title: Patagonia Overland
subtitle: Twelve Days Through Chile and Argentina's Wild South
overview: A 12-day overland circuit through the best of Chilean and Argentine Patagonia — Torres del Paine, the Perito Moreno Glacier, El Chaltén, and a private estancia stay. This itinerary balances serious trekking with cultural immersion and extraordinary wildlife.
highlights: Trek to the base of the iconic Torres del Paine granite towers
Walk on Perito Moreno Glacier with crampons
Search for pumas on guided wildlife drives
Gaucho experience on a private estancia

days.title: Gateway to the South
days.description: Arrive in Punta Arenas, the windswept city at the tip of South America. Transfer to your hotel and evening briefing.

days.title: Enter the Park
days.description: Drive north to Torres del Paine National Park, stopping at the Laguna Amarga checkpoint. First views of the iconic towers take the breath away. Afternoon hike to Mirador Las Torres.

days.title: The Valley of the Wind
days.description: Trek the Valle del Francés — a glacial valley flanked by hanging glaciers and towering granite walls, with the constant thunder of ice calving above.

days.title: Puma Territory
days.description: Today is dedicated to wildlife. With our specialist puma guide and spotting scopes, we patrol the southern sections of the park where pumas are regularly habituated to vehicles.

days.title: Grey Glacier
days.description: Trek to Glaciar Grey and take a short boat trip among the icebergs. The glacier calves regularly into Lago Grey, creating a sculptural landscape of drifting ice.

days.title: Rest and Restore
days.description: A rest day in Puerto Natales — visit the excellent regional museum, explore the local market, or choose an optional half-day kayak on the Seno Última Esperanza.

days.title: Cross the Border
days.description: Cross into Argentina and drive to El Calafate on the shores of Lago Argentino. First views of the Southern Patagonian Ice Field on the horizon.

days.title: On the Ice
days.description: A full day at Perito Moreno — one of the world's few advancing glaciers. First, walk the boardwalk catwalks for panoramic views, then strap on crampons for a 2-hour guided trek across the ancient ice.

days.title: Trekking Capital
days.description: Drive north to El Chaltén, Argentina's trekking capital at the foot of Mount Fitz Roy. Afternoon hike to Laguna de los Tres for the iconic Fitz Roy reflection.

days.title: Fitz Roy Circuit
days.description: A longer day hike exploring the forests, moraines, and viewpoints above El Chaltén, with opportunities for condor watching on the thermals.

days.title: Life on the Estancia
days.description: Return south to a private estancia — a working Patagonian sheep ranch. Learn from the gauchos, try your hand at horsemanship, and dine on slow-roasted lamb asado under the open sky.

days.title: Journey's End
days.description: Transfer to Punta Arenas for onward flights, carrying the memory of a landscape that redefines one's sense of scale and possibility.
